main_text.p: דִּין Syr. Autem, Verò, Ex Græco δέ, ܐܝܢ [?] Igi-tur, Itaque, ܐܢ [?]. Vide etiam דִּין.
דִּיץ דִּיצָא Ch. Caprea, Pygargus, Deut.14.5. emph. דִּיצְתָּא Prov.5.19.
דִּיק דִּיוּקְנָא Ch. Effigies, Imago, similitudo. Est ex Græco εἰκὼν. Plur. דִּיוּקְנִין Levit.26.1.Jon.
דִּיר Chald. Limbus, corona. Hebr. זוֹר. Vide & in דּוּר.
דִּית Syr. Testamentum, pactum, fœdus. Græc. διαθήκη. Plur. ܕܝܬܢܐ [?], Pactiones. Ex Græco διαθήκαις, ad Gal.4.24. Cum aff. ܕܝܬܗ [?]. Et recordatus est pactionum suarum, Luc.1.72.
דִּיךְ Ch. Hic, iste, is. Dicitur & דִּיכִי, דִּכִי cum י in fine. Fœmin. דִּךְ Hæc, ea, ista.

דְּכָא Ch.&Syr. Purum, mundum esse, Purū pronunciare vel habere, mundari, purgari. Pahel דַּכִּי, דַּכִּי Mundare, emundare, purificare, purum pronunciare. Ithpah. אִתְדַּכִּי, & Syr. ܐܬܕܟܝ [?] Mundari, mundare, purificare se.
דְּכוּתָא, דְּכוּת, דְּכוּתָא Ch. Purgatio, purificatio, mundatio, emundatio.
דְּכִי Chal. ܕܟܝܐ [?] Syr.Purus,mundus. Plur. ܕܟܝܢ [?] Mun-di. Fœ-

page.notes: Syriac and some Hebrew-pointed forms are read with doubt and marked [?]. The Greek in the entry "Ex Græco" lines and the Syriac plural forms are approximate. The entry text runs on to the next page at "Fœ-".
